ruleName: Ball lost in abnormal course conditions
title: Free relief for lost ball in abnormal course conditions
question: You are certain your ball is lost in an area marked as abnormal course conditions (like ground under repair), but you can’t find it. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Play a new ball from the tee with a penalty
Take free relief by dropping a ball at the spot where your original ball last crossed the edge of the abnormal course condition
Drop another ball anywhere on the course without penalty
Search for your ball for 10 minutes

explanation: If you are certain your ball is lost in abnormal course conditions, you may take free relief by dropping a ball at the point where the ball last crossed the edge of that area, with no penalty.

juniorVersion.title: What to do if your ball is lost in a special area like ground under repair
juniorVersion.question: You hit your ball and you are sure it went into a muddy area with a sign that says 'ground under repair', but you can’t find your ball. What are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Hit a new ball from the tee and add a penalty stroke
Drop a ball for free where your ball last went into the bad area
Drop a ball for free anywhere you want on the course
Look for your ball for 10 minutes

juniorVersion.explanation: If you are sure your ball is lost in a spot like 'ground under repair', you can drop a new ball for free near where your ball went in, at the edge of the area.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A muddy, wet, or damaged spot on the course with a sign. You get special help if your ball goes in here.
Letting go of a ball from knee height, so it can be played again.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Explain that 'ground under repair' is a special spot to help the grass or fix problems, so golfers don’t have to play from there.
likelyMisconceptions: Children may think they always have to take a penalty when the ball is lost.
Kids might believe they can drop the ball anywhere for free relief.
They may think they can search for the ball longer than the rules allow.
